intro: Academiya was founded on a simple belief: anyone can learn the markets when the teaching is honest, structured and grounded in reality. We pair credible, practitioner-led courses with the live data and tools traders actually use — so you don't just learn, you lead.
story: Academiya is a modern trading academy built to take you from complete beginner to confident, risk-aware trader. We teach forex, crypto and stock-market skills through structured video courses, live classes and a supportive community. Our instructors are working traders and analysts — not faceless gurus. Every course is built around a repeatable process, disciplined risk management and honest expectations. We believe education, not hype, is what creates lasting traders. Join thousands of students learning the right way, at their own pace, with lifetime access
